root_cause_label: Solution never builds staircase; missing drop-based elevation logic
one_sentence_failure_summary: The model never implements the drop-based staircase-building mechanic required to reach level-8 gold, instead repeatedly rewriting movement and pickup logic without ever addressing the fundamental algorithmic gap, so every trial times out.
t_err_evidence: Agent writes solution.js with flawed strategy lacking proper drop/stair-building logic to reach level 8 gold.
t_commit_evidence: From step 4 onward the agent never transitions to a design that correctly transports blocks to a build site and drops them there; every subsequent rewrite (steps 6, 8, 9, 12, 14, 15, 17, 18, 20) perpetuates the same missing-staircase flaw, locking in failure.
t_surface_evidence: timeout 30 node test_runner.js again outputs only 'DEBUG: invoking game.run(3)' with no trial completion.
trigger_explanation: The agent understands that gold is at level 8 and blocks can be picked up and dropped, but lacks the domain insight that winning requires repeatedly ferrying blocks from source cells to a designated build site adjacent to the gold and dropping them there — without re-picking from the build cell — to accumulate elevation incrementally. All attempts omit this spatial transport plan.
